verdict: Clean, fully real implementation verified against the CEM. Uses only genuine Baklava API: bl-dialog with real open/critical/caption attributes, content in the default slot, and the two real action slots primary-action (Delete) and secondary-action (Cancel); bl-button with real variant values (primary/secondary) and kind="danger" for the destructive confirm action; listens to the real bl-click and bl-dialog-request-close events. No hallucinated tags, attributes, slots, or events. The modal correctly blocks the background and exposes a dangerous confirm plus a safe cancel.
